title: Do not add explicit exit 1 guards to AND-linked YAML execution jobs
summary: When authoring YAML-specification execution jobs whose runner already AND-links commands and propagates failures, do not insert redundant explicit `exit 1` statements or shell error-exit guards in the YAML commands. Rely on the job's existing command-failure behavior instead.

conditions: The YAML runner already AND-links commands and propagates errors.
exceptions: Does not permit inventing substitute repositories or unrelated changes.
